title: TEST CHAMBER 10
pa: Gravity assistance has been approved for this trial.
Do not attempt to launch the heavy crate uphill.

addedBoxes.note: North guide rail keeps the rolling crate aligned with the plate.
South guide rail prevents the crate leaving the ramp sideways.
End stop catches the crate over the floor plate, well beyond the arm's reach.
Low sightline blocker partly conceals the ramp from the base spawn.
First concealed staff step; top at 0.75 m.
Second staff step; top at 1.50 m.
Third staff step; top at 2.25 m.
Fourth staff step; top at 3.00 m.
Fifth staff step; top at 3.75 m.
High east passage joins the fifth step and stays above the low door opening.
Fix: staff bridge from the high walkway north to the shell catwalk at the real staff hatch (z -4.5); the walkway alone dead-ends at the wall above the door.

solution: Reach the button at (-5.9, 2.1, 3.4) with the arm and press it to open the shutter and high hatch.
Use the drone to zap the high panel on the north-west side and set override.

Use the arm to start the crate rolling down the steel ramp from (4.55, 1.65, 0.65); the yellow rails feed it to the plate at (9.75, 0.65). Do not try to throw it uphill or carry it to the distant plate.
Walk the base out through the low east exit when override and plate are active.
Hidden: after the button, override and plate, follow the small alternating steps against the south wall, with rises of 0.75 m, to the upper east staff hatch above y = 3.
